component.name: lilbee-rocm
component.summary: The whole local AI stack in one executable (AMD ROCm build)

description.p: lilbee is the whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU you have, indexes your files and code, crawls the web pages you point it at, and answers questions with citations down to the file and line. One install covers the TUI, CLI, HTTP server, and MCP server. You don't need Ollama or LM Studio, and it works with both.

This build offloads inference to an AMD GPU via ROCm. The ROCm userspace ships inside it, so it needs only the amdgpu kernel driver on the host; without a usable GPU it falls back to the CPU. Run it with GPU access enabled (flatpak --device=all).
